new_en: You smile politely and move on, the music fading behind you as the crowd swallows you up.
You stop for a moment and let the music wash over you.
The noise of the promenade seems to fall away. You stay until the song ends, then carry on your way. <<stress -6>><<lstress>>
The tune is familiar enough that you find yourself singing along under your breath.
The <> raises an eyebrow. As the song carries on, you find your footing, matching the melody without much effort. A few tourists slow down to have a listen.
When the song ends, <<he>> gives you a pleased smile.
"Hey, you can actually sing." <<He>> laughs, shaking <<his>> head. "Seriously though, that was lovely. Come back any time." <<stress -8>><<lstress>>
You stumble over a few words and lose your place. The <> chuckles but doesn't comment on it.<><>
